summary: Independent exact reconstruction and Chinese-source review of all nineteen claim and nineteen paired hint conversions rejects the candidate. Eighteen conversions correctly remove unsupported chronology. Yuan Huiye (p004) correctly retains AD 550 reduction/enfeoffment and AD 551 political/death chronology in claim-104/105/107/109/110 and his active hints, but claim-141 still carries an unsupported AD 516-529 interval inside its unresolved dateContext. Marking it unresolved does not make that interval source-supported; remove it while retaining sourceDate 建元元年 and the legal event, then submit a corrected candidate for fresh review.
